capabilities: Fetch new watched movies from Trakt history and create movie notes
Reconstruct full-album listens from Last.fm scrobbles with a session detector
Render imported data through user-supplied Templater templates via a payload handshake
Mark re-watches and re-listens instead of creating duplicate notes
Flag low-confidence MusicBrainz album matches with needs_review and a warning callout
extras: Setup requires building from source (npm install && npm run build) and symlinking the repo into the vault. Last.fm only records listens from first run forward (no backfill), while Trakt offers a one-time backfill. The README warns it depends on Templater's internal API, so a Templater rewrite could break it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically pull watch and listen history from Trakt or Last.fm into templated notes.

requires.name: Trakt client ID/secret and Last.fm API key

summary: Imports Trakt movie watches and Last.fm full-album listens into vault notes rendered through your own Templater movie and album templates.
